name: Firehouse Pizzeria (Garden City) Breakfast Egg Pizza, Cheese Pizza & Focaccia Bread
brandOrRestaurant: Firehouse Pizzeria (Garden City / Bear Lake, UT)
whyItWorks: Stone-fired pizzeria offering a morning Breakfast Pizza (scrambled eggs, potatoes, and cheddar), warm focaccia bread, and plain cheese/chicken pizzas.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Breakfast Egg & Cheddar Pizza or a simple Cheese/Chicken Pizza (and skip the spicy "Down South Cajun Pasta").
watchOuts: Avoid the Down South Cajun Pizza and Cajun Pasta (spicy capsaicin)
